rainfall.variable: hourly precipitation, preceding-hour sum, totalled for the next 24 hours
rainfall.model: Same Open-Meteo forecast call as the hotspot alerts. Open-Meteo documents hourly precipitation and soil_moisture_0_to_7cm on the ECMWF IFS HRES forecast: 9 km, updated every 6 hours (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/ecmwf-api).
rainfall.grid: Sampled at 0.1°, bilinear onto the 30 m analysis grid, clipped to the ensemble footprint.

not_used.name: CHIRPS v3
not_used.why: Pentad rainfall. The preliminary file is released two days after a pentad ends, and the final file the following month. It is a monitoring climatology, not a forecast. The 30-year mean already in cog/rainfall.tif stays the static conditioning factor.

not_used.name: NASA GPM IMERG Early
not_used.why: 0.1° half-hourly satellite rain, about 4 hours late, but the granules are on NASA GES DISC and need an Earthdata login. Not fetched.

soil_moisture.model: ECMWF IFS volumetric soil water in the top 7 cm, via Open-Meteo. The alert gate already accepts 0 to 0.7. The watch line used on occupied slopes is 0.40.

not_used.name: NASA SMAP
not_used.why: SMAP L4 is a 9 km soil-moisture analysis, but it is behind Earthdata and is not fetched. This layer is the forecast the alerts already read, not a SMAP map.

population.model: WorldPop 2020, UN-adjusted, unconstrained 1 km India grid, dasymetrically placed onto Google Open Buildings centroids. Pixels with nobody counted are left transparent so the drape shows where people are, not a flat wash. Census village tables are not in this extract.
population.citation: WorldPop and CIESIN, Columbia University (2018). Global High Resolution Population Denominators Project. Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation (OPP1134076). https://www.worldpop.org
